# PR Readiness Review

Use this before publishing or merging implementation work.

Check:

- Formatter and static analysis pass using the project's own commands.
- Tests relevant to the change pass.
- No debug artifacts, temporary files, secrets, generated noise, or accidental
  large binaries are included.
- Commit history is understandable and avoids accidental work-in-progress
  commits unless the project accepts them.
- The PR title and description describe the user-facing change, validation, and
  risk.
